quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Chen Renxi (results briefing): Q1 2026 revenue was RMB 81.41 hundred million, up 45.09% year on year, and net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 11.58 hundred million, up 105.47%; facing high raw-material costs the company pursued a 'raise quality, control volume' strategy while pushing market certifications and development at key end customers. Orders are currently full.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 revenue RMB 81.41 hundred million (+45.09%); net profit RMB 11.58 hundred million (+105.47%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Shengyi Technology results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Chen Renxi (results briefing): the new Jiangxi phase 2, Changshu and Thailand projects are entering production one after another and, once fully in production, will add about 2850 ten-thousand square metres (about 2280 ten-thousand sheets) of copper-clad laminate capacity a year. The Songshan Lake high-performance CCL project, with total investment of about RMB 52 hundred million and planned annual capacity of 4,800 ten-thousand square metres (about 3840 ten-thousand sheets) of CCL and 10,000 ten-thousand metres of prepreg, will be built in two phases and is expected to start in H2 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: about 2850 ten-thousand square metres of new CCL capacity a year; Songshan Lake project about RMB 52 hundred million, 4,800 ten-thousand square metres
